media.intro: See what is playing and control it. This runs on the device through the media service (OCP).
media.liveNote: The track position does not update on its own. Use Refresh to see the latest now-playing information.
media.unavailable: No media service is running. Install and start ovos-media (or the OCP audio plugin) to use this page.
media.nowPlaying.title: Now playing
media.candidates.title: What else this matched
media.candidates.hint: The device chose from these. Pick another to play it instead — no need to ask again.
media.likes.title: Songs you liked
media.likes.none: Nothing liked yet. The heart on a playing track adds it here.
media.noBackends: This device has no way to play audio: the media service is running, but no playback backend is loaded. Requests to play something are accepted and nothing comes out. Install a media plugin from the Plugins page.
media.transport.title: Transport
media.notPlayable: The player cannot play that one.
